name: Financial Services Credit, KYB/AML & Claims Underwriting
description: Calculates commercial borrower DSCR, net leverage, and interest coverage under multi-shock stress scenarios, resolves multi-hop UBO beneficial ownership with AML velocity/structuring checks, and evaluates insurance claims deterministically.

skills.summary: Calculates DSCR, Net Leverage, Interest Coverage, and Current Ratio across Base, -10%/-20% revenue, and +200bps rate shocks.
Traverses multi-hop holding DAGs to compute cumulative UBO ownership %, enforces 10% EDD drop, and detects velocity/structuring spikes.
Validates policy effective periods and peril exclusions, computes deductible/coinsurance/sublimit payouts, and flags >$100k reserves.

byo_mcp: KYB / Sanctions Screening & Core Banking / Claims Clearinghouse MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Retrieve borrower financials, corporate ownership graphs, wire ledger transactions, and policy claim schedules from BigQuery, Snowflake, or customer KYB/Claims MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python graph and covenant checks.

gateway_approval_actions: Submitting commercial credit underwriting decisions or covenant waivers in core banking/LOS MCP
Filing regulatory SAR/STR narratives or freezing customer banking accounts via AML MCP
Authorizing claim settlement reserve releases or disbursement payouts via Claims MCP
python_code_guardrails: Transitive ownership graph multiplication catching sub-threshold pass-through structures (>=10% EDD / >=25% UBO)
Sub-$10k structuring velocity burst detection and hard base/stress DSCR & leverage covenant breaches
Per-occurrence deductible, coverage sublimit, and policy exclusion net indemnity math

scheduled_routine.name: daily-kyb-velocity-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Daily KYB Velocity & Structuring Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the daily AML transaction velocity and structuring sweep via scripts/ubo_velocity_screener.py across active corporate banking accounts and flag EDD alerts for MLRO review.
